name: Enzyme-catalysed capture
principle: Carbonic anhydrase enzyme speeds up CO2 hydration in a non-toxic, non-volatile solvent, so capture can run on low-grade heat. Saipem sells it as Bluenzyme; the first product, Bluenzyme 200, has a nominal capacity of 200 t CO2 per day and was tested within the EU ACCSESS project.

source.note: Digital Refining, Bluenzyme sustainable CO2 capture solution from Saipem

limitations: No energy or capture-rate figures in the article
